mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( uuid, created_at, updated_at, status ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, DEFAULT )

INSERT INTO user_info (uuid, name, nickname, address, address_detail, zipcode, bio, profile_url, birth_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{addressDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bio, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT PREFIX_TEXT FROM (SELECT PREFIX_TEXT FROM PLANT_NICKNAME_PREFIX ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) || ' ' || (SELECT COMMON_NAME FROM (SELECT COMMON_NAME FROM PLANT_INFO ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS NICKNAME FROM dual
SELECT ui.*, a.email, a.phone FROM user_info ui LEFT JOIN auth a ON ui.uuid = a.user_uid WHERE ui.uuid = #{uid}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET name = #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, nickname = #{nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address = #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, address_detail = #{addressDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, zipcode = #{zipcode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, bio = #{bio, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, profile_url = #{profileUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, birth_date = #{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ROLE( USER_UID, ROLE_ID, ASSIGNED_BY, ASSIGNED_AT )VALUES ( #{userUid}, #{roleId}, #{assignedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT r.ROLE_NAME FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON ur.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_UID = #{userUid}
